Some archs (specifically PowerPC)
column2: are sensitive with the ordering of

column1: the enabling of the calls to function tracing and setting of the
function to use to be traced.
That is
column2: update_ftrace_function() sets what function the ftrace_caller

column1: trampoline should call. Some archs require this to be set before
calling ftrace_run_update_code().
Another bug was discovered
ftrace_run_update_code() directly. If the function the ftrace_caller
trampoline changes
column2: then it will not be updated. Instead a call

column1: to ftrace_startup_enable() should be called because it tests to see
if the callback changed since the code was disabled
tell the arch to update appropriately. Most archs do not need this
notification
The problem could be seen by the following commands:
# echo 0 > /proc/sys/kernel/ftrace_enabled
# echo function > /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/current_tracer
# echo 1 > /proc/sys/kernel/ftrace_enabled
# cat /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/trace
The trace will show that function tracing was not active.
